description: What the validation-skeptic-agent applies to every candidate. The verdict is KILLED unless the canonical statistical gate passes AND every required adversarial check is reported passed WITH a measured value. The sha256 of this file is bound into every pre-registration; a review under a different hash is refused, which is what 'thresholds frozen before final evaluation' means in code.

canonical_statistical_gate.rule: The skeptic DELEGATES the statistical verdict. It never re-implements it and never relaxes it.

inherited_thresholds.source: alpha_agent.r59 (inherited from R57/R58 so results stay comparable)

canonical_statistical_gate.observation_rule: EFFECTIVE observations are used when the evaluator reports them; an overlapping-window book's raw period count is not its sample size.
canonical_statistical_gate.burden_rule: Every candidate is charged for its family's prior tests, for every settled agent experiment in the campaign, and for its own within-family multiplicity (a horizon sweep of four is four draws).

report_shape.evidence: artifact path or short statement, REQUIRED

adversarial_checks.unmeasured_rule: A check reported passed without a measured value counts as FAILED.

required.attack: every input was observable at the decision instant; fundamentals use filing availability, never period end; delisted names and expired contracts retained
the signal is unchanged when all data after t is destroyed; the return is realised strictly after t, from an executable entry
the candidate beats a permuted-signal placebo on the same panel and cost model by the pre-registered margin
the lockbox net result stays positive at twice the pre-registered cost
the effect is not produced by one subperiod, one instrument or one event
the realised decision-by-decision ordering is not a monotone re-expression of a settled hypothesis (rank fingerprint / |Spearman| >= 0.999)

machine_checked.rule: the submitted signal_sign equals the pre-registered expected_sign; computed by the pipeline, not reported by an agent
the submitted cost model equals the pre-registered cost model; computed by the pipeline
measured turnover per decision (one side) <= max_turnover_per_decision_one_side; computed by the pipeline

FUTURES_PER_MARKET.rule: preferred over the flat default wherever it is owned

outcome_mapping.SURVIVED: NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE until risk, meta and director have ruled; only director_clear writes QUALIFIED

no_rescue_rule: A killed candidate is never re-run with altered parameters, a flipped sign, a different sample or a softer cost to obtain a pass. A control or by-product that looks strong is not adoptable; it needs a fresh human-authorised pre-registration on untouched data.
